name: Boiler furnace and membrane water walls
description: Radiant heat-release enclosure around the flame. Fire-tube boilers confine the flame in a large furnace tube surrounded by water; water-tube boilers use finned membrane wall panels in which the furnace walls themselves form evaporator surface. Cooling the gas before the reversal chamber and limiting metal subcooling during cycling are central to tube life.
